migration_and_rollback.projection_note: This packet changes documentation and focused tests only; deleting this packet or reverting its two contract-hardening commits does not alter production runtime behavior or authority.

title: Pin canonical relation observer scalar semantics

masterplan.gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

issue_scope.priority: resolve the scalar-observer boundary isolated by GPU-47 without adding a second compiler or reinterpreting Forest weights

finding.contract_drift: The strict one-relation Forest/Fourfold adapter correctly remained Boolean-only because raw Forest payloads do not define generic weighted scalar meaning, while the existing canonical multi-relation compiler already had executable Boolean, natural and evidence-dag admission semantics over normalized semantic facts and evidence bundles. The reference contract still described natural/evidence Forest projection as deferred, leaving the implemented higher-level compiler semantics insufficiently specified.
finding.semantic_risk: Without an explicit contract, a future change could incorrectly count multiple evidence witnesses as natural relation multiplicity, collapse evidence alternatives into a natural count, or treat protocol backend substitution as permission to redefine the persisted algebra.

decision.summary: Specify and pin the semantics already centralized in compile_relation_blocks: a deduplicated semantic coordinate is True under Boolean, unit 1 under natural, and the canonical alternative evidence bundles under evidence-dag. Natural multiplicity is created by semiring composition of distinct semantic paths, not by duplicate ingestion witnesses. ForestEdge.weight remains outside this contract and tropical compilation remains refused. Protocol backends with a supported semantic name remain substitutable while canonical persisted algebra stays authoritative.
decision.gardener_note: No production helper, registry, compiler path, adapter or backend was added because the current three-case scalar admission already has one owner. The packet removes documentation ambiguity and adds focused executable evidence instead of creating an abstraction solely to restate existing behavior.

focused_contracts: two Forest witnesses for one semantic coordinate compile to Boolean True rather than duplicate sparse entries
the same two witnesses compile to natural scalar 1 so evidence multiplicity does not masquerade as path multiplicity
the evidence-dag observer retains both canonical alternative witness bundles for the one semantic coordinate
a protocol backend that implements the canonical natural semantic name remains admissible and produces the canonical unit scalar
ForestEdge.weight is not reinterpreted as natural multiplicity or tropical cost

verification.diagnostic_profiles: Python 3.12/hash-0 CPU-bitset and TypedRelationBlock profiles completed; claim none

claims.correctness: canonical multi-relation compiler observer scalar semantics are now explicit and regression-pinned without changing production behavior
